blocking_issues: AFS_LIC_PRE_FSR is mapped as one raw string observation even though the help file explicitly documents multiple previous licences separated by '~', and licence.pre_fsr_reference is many-valued and calls for each reference separately. A row with multiple prior references would therefore produce one packed payload rather than one observation per reference. The mapping could split only on the documented '~' separator, retain each resulting reference verbatim, or leave this source field unmapped.

AFS_LIC_CONDITION is likewise mapped as one raw packed string, while the source documentation says conditions are represented as tilde-separated condition lines or rows and the ontology requires each source condition or row as a separate observation. In the discovery examples, one field contains many '~'-separated parts. Preserve the interior text without interpretation if desired, but split on the documented separator or leave the field unmapped.
warnings: The exploration snippet failed because `records` was undefined; the supplied discovery records and source documentation still provide direct evidence for this review.

The mapping's high confidence values are judgments rather than calibrated probabilities. They appear broadly consistent with the explicit field definitions, but validation passing establishes parse/type behavior, not semantic accuracy.
evidence_checked: Help File pp. 8-11: AFS_LIC_NUM identifies the licence; AFS_LIC_NAME is a register-entry name and may be an individual or organisation; AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is either ABN or ACN; AFS_LIC_START_DT is a licence start date; address fields are current principal-business-address components; conditions are current licence authorisations.

Help File p. 9: AFS_LIC_PRE_FSR can contain multiple previous licences, each delimited by '~'; discovery row 2 contains one encoded previous reference and other preview rows show blanks or references.
Help File p. 11: AFS_LIC_CONDITION has documented tilde-delimited condition lines or rows; discovery records contain multiple such parts in a single field.
Dataset notes and Help File p. 3: the published dataset is a point-in-time snapshot of current licensees; no status field is present.
Supplied ontology definitions: licence.pre_fsr_reference is many-valued and retains each reference; licence.authorisation_condition is many-valued and retains each source condition or row separately.
Mapping avoids treating AFS_LIC_NAME as entity.legal_name, maps AFS_LIC_START_DT to licence.start_date, does not invent active status, and does not map register metadata to an unsupported concept.

Trusted engine semantics: ABN/ACN validation is checksum-based and disjoint by accepted identifier length; licence-holder claims with valid explicit identifiers are permitted; publication_proxy is allowed and does not represent row-change time.

warnings: The source documentation describes current licensees in a point-in-time snapshot but does not supply an explicit row-level licence or legal-entity status; the mapping correctly avoids inventing one and discloses this limitation.

AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is an either/or ABN/ACN source column. Separate mappings are semantically acceptable under the supplied checksum and identifier-exclusivity engine semantics; the sample evidence shown includes an ABN, not a demonstrated ACN case.

The principal-business-address fields provide components rather than a street address, and source blanks may indicate failed address validation. The mapping does not fabricate a full address and discloses this limitation.
Tilde splitting retains the source's embedded quoted structures rather than normalizing their legal meaning, consistent with the supplied definitions and sample payloads.
evidence_checked: Help File pp. 3, 8–11: point-in-time snapshot of current licensees; AFS_LIC_NUM uniquely identifies the licensee; AFS_LIC_NAME is the register-entry name and may be a person or organisation; AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN contains ABN if provided, else ACN; start date is the licence start date; principal business address definitions and validation caveats; tilde-delimited prior references and conditions.

Discovery records: licence numbers, organisation-style and register-entry names, mixed ABN/ACN values, DD/MM/YYYY start dates, principal address locality/state/postcode/country, and sample tilde-delimited prior-reference and condition text.

Mapping preserves AFS_LIC_NAME as licence.register_entry_name rather than legal or trading name; uses licence_holder role and does not infer company form or group ownership; does not map unsupported status, trading names, branches, or reporting groups.

Supplied engine semantics: valid ABN/ACN checksums and disjoint accepted lengths; source claims retain row provenance; licence_holder role is permitted; publication_proxy is allowed when labelled; sentinel International is not a country claim.
